info.title: magicsuite
info.description: The Magic Suite command-line interface: read and change Magic Suite data through the API, manage files and tenants, and talk to Merlin, from a terminal, a script or an AI assistant. Documentation: https://docs.magicsuite.net/AdvancedTopics/Cli

commands.name: api
commands.description:
Perform CRUD operations on Magic Suite entities via the API.
AVAILABLE COMMANDS:
get - List entities with filtering and pagination
get-by-id      - Get a single entity by its ID
create         - Create a new entity
patch   - Update specific properties of an entity
delete         - Delete an entity by ID
execute        - Start a schedule, re-run a batch job, or run a DataMagic sync
aggregate      - Hourly roll-ups of Meraki DataMagic network events or client history
export         - Export a complete entity configuration graph to a JSON document
import         - Import a complete entity configuration graph from a JSON document

commands.name: login
commands.description:
Opens your browser to the Microsoft sign-in page (MFA included), then stores a Magic Suite session in the profile. An API token configured with 'auth token' keeps working and takes precedence.
The Microsoft application (client) ID comes from --client-id, MAGICSUITE_AZURE_CLIENT_ID or the profile, and is remembered in the profile after a successful sign-in. The application must allow public client sign-in with the redirect http://localhost.

commands.description:
Manage CLI configuration and profiles.
Profile store: <path> Data/MagicSuite/cli-config.json
Backups (the 20 most recent writes): <path> Data/MagicSuite/backups
Token keys are stored in plain text, in the store and in every backup and export.
